# external/

The container protocol's actions.

| | |
|---|---|
| [create/](create/) | makes the replica: its mrepo and its container |
| [start/](start/) | starts the container, the replica's runtime in it |
| [stop/](stop/) | stops the container |
| [remove/](remove/) | removes the container, the replica's folder and its link |
| [status/](status/) | the state of the replica's container |
